to say

Doric φαμί [I say] in lyric passages. The forms of the present indicative are enclitic, except the second person, which some grammarians wrote φής [you say] with iota subscript, others without iota: on which see Thes. vol. 8 p. 740. The first aorist is ἔφησα [I said], the second (not imperfect) is ἔφην [I said], with subjunctive φῶ [I may say], future φήσω [I will say].
I say.
οὔ φημι [I do not say] I deny.
